data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word ‘masa’udah’ which means ‘helpful’ or ‘able’. In Islamic tradition, Masouda is a name for girls symbolizing their innate ability to help and support others. The name Masouda carries the meaning “Helpful, Able” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Masouda usually hope their child will grow to embody helpful, able and live with faith, good character and purpose.
